chunks.text: Abstract. This study examines catalyst loading of 15 mg and reaction yield.
Methods. The experiment used sample ID 7781 with baseline pressure 101325 pascals.
Results. The experiment showed that increasing temperature improved the reaction rate by 42 percent.
Discussion. The experimental method produced more accurate measurements than prior work.
Conclusion. The paper summarizes the history of experimental chemistry in this domain.
